clauses.text: Prices as per the price annex, fixed for each calendar year. Changes require written notice of at least 90 days before the end of the calendar year.
Delivery DAP; standard lead time 7 days from order.
The quality agreement applies: on-time delivery target 95 %, flat fee of EUR 150 per supplier-caused complaint.
Valid from 2025-07-01 to 2027-06-30; extends by 12 months unless terminated with 90 days' notice.

documents.text: Annual review with Normteile Brucker KG. Their key account manager explained that price changes above 2 % need the approval of their pricing committee, which meets every two weeks.

documents.text: Annual review with Normteile Brucker KG. Their sales director said there is no room on price this year: head office has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. He was open on payment terms and call-off flexibility.

quote_remarks.remarks: Prices as per current list; discounts not possible this year (head-office directive).

persona.summary: Small family KG (29 M EUR, 60 staff); we are 0.28 %. Head office froze all price reductions until December 2027 and its list applies to all customers; it offers payment terms and call-off flexibility instead. Sole source for stud bolt M10 A2-70; 70610 is second source on the washer but dearer. Yet it settled below its own ask on the stud bolt three years running. Trade on terms, not list price.
persona.notes: Wants a uniform price list and multi-year volume; open on payment and logistics. We pay late (34 % of invoices >5 days). Contradictions: a 60-staff family KG cites a head office and pricing committee; 'no discounts' vs stud bolt down 12.4 % since first price. OTD 88 % vs 95 %, 51 complaints, 1 open 8D.

arguments: multi-year binding volume (its stated route to price changes)
stud bolt history: settled below its own ask 3 years running
avoid: a list-price cut as the headline (head-office freeze)
rival quote on the washer (70610 is dearer)
changing terms after its final offer
mandatory_terms: uniform list price, no discounts until 2027-12
tactics: Expect the price to hold near list; take value in payment days, call-off flexibility and contract length.
Offer a multi-year binding volume, the only route to price it names, and ask for a price for that package.
Use the quality record once: OTD 88 % against a 95 % target, 51 complaints, 1 open 8D.
Keep each price step at or below 2 % to stay under its pricing-committee threshold.
Never reopen terms after its final offer.
playbook.expected_concession: No arena data; the freeze (to Dec 2027) suggests little list-price movement and value mainly on terms; before it, the stud bolt settled 1-3 points below its own ask.
